questions.question:

Carpet area required per student = 1.2 sq.m.
Area of corridors, Verandah etc. = 20% of plinth area

Area of Walls = 15% of plinth area.
Cost of water supply work = 5% of building cost.
Cost of sanitary = 7% of building cost.
Cost of electrification = 12% of building cost.
Cost of approach road and boundary walls = 3% of building cost.
Contingencies and work charge establishments shall be 5% and 2.5% of the total cost respectively.
